description: Defines enums, structs, and functions related to CSI report configuration in a 5G NR context, including report types, codebook configurations, and subband settings.

classes.name: ri_restriction_type
classes.description: A bitset representing RI restrictions, with a width of 8 bits.

classes.name: csi_report_subband_configuration
classes.description: Configuration parameters for CSI report subbands, including CQI and PMI enable flags and number of subbands.

classes.name: csi_report_configuration
classes.description: Main configuration struct for CSI reports, including resource count, codebook type, RI restrictions, report quantities, and optional subband configuration.
